description: This file defines a custom exception class `MeetingNotSupportedResourceException` that extends `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException`. It is used to signal that a meeting was captured against an unsupported resource within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: MeetingNotSupportedResourceException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a meeting was attempted to be associated with a resource that is not supported.

methods.name: MeetingNotSupportedResourceException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message key and optional arguments.
